body: Clinical language models can achieve strong in-hospital accuracy yet fail under deployment shifts because they exploit note-specific artifacts (e.g., templates, separators, boilerplate) that do not reflect patient state. We propose CAST (Concept-guided Artifact Suppression Tuning), an SAE-based framework for auditable clinical text classification. CAST uses Sparse Autoencoders to expose sparse, human-auditable features from intermediate Transformer activations, labels SAE latents with an LLM-assisted interpretation pipeline and ICD-10 retrieval constraints, suppresses verified artifact latents via residual subtraction during fine-tuning, and provides post-hoc per-concept attributions for auditing model decisions. On MIMIC-IV discharge-note mortality prediction, CAST improves over its corresponding fine-tuned encoder baselines and remains competitive with strong LLM baselines, while producing a feature-level audit trail of the clinical concepts that support each prediction and the artifact concepts suppressed during training.
summaryZh: 本文针对临床大模型在实际部署中因过度拟合笔记模板等伪影而导致性能下降的问题，提出了CAST（概念引导伪影抑制微调）框架。该方法利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）从Transformer中间激活中提取人类可审计的特征，并通过LLM辅助标注与ICD-10约束进行特征分类。在微调过程中，CAST通过残差减法抑制已验证的伪影特征，在MIMIC-IV数据集上实现了比传统微调更优的性能，并为模型决策提供了可审计的特征级证据链，显著增强了临床预测的可靠性。

glossary.explanationZh: 一种用于从神经网络激活中提取可解释、稀疏特征的无监督学习模型。
通过技术手段消除模型训练数据中非本质特征（如模板、格式）对预测结果的干扰。
模型内部表示中提取出的潜在特征向量。
在模型预测后，对影响决策的关键特征进行归因分析的方法。
广泛用于医疗人工智能研究的重症监护电子病历数据库。
